title: save_data_location input
description: This store exists, moved, or is gone: registers or changes up to 100 data locations (O25), each held as a link with an external ID or a URL and the date it was last seen. A location is matched again on its platform and external ID (or URL). An AI client's location is a draft until a person confirms it. Connection strings, keys and passwords are refused (G-22). A location goes two levels deep at most: an instance, then a store inside it (G-24).

dataLocationId.description: The location to change. Leave it out to register one.

parentLocationId.description: The instance this store sits in.

targetStageKey.description: Required on a top-level location. A child takes its parent's stage.

deploymentTargetId.description: When the store is a deployment target the register knows.

hostedByApplicationId.description: The business application this system is.

linkKindKey.description: A link kind of the data-location category. The platform's default when left out.

externalId.description: The tool's own ID. Give this or url.

url.description: Opens the location in its own tool.

seenNow.description: True records that the location was seen now.

confirm.description: True confirms the location. A person's save confirms unless this is false. An AI client never confirms (G-21).

retire.description: True retires the location (Retired On today) instead of deleting it.
